endpoints.description: 📊 Retrieve Your Account and Usage Statistics
details: Retrieve details about your account and usage statistics.
This endpoint provides comprehensive details about your account, including usage statistics and activity records.
Usage Tracking: The endpoint tracks your API usage and provides insights into your activity.
Rate Limiting: The request generates a usage record each time it is called.
Real-time Data: Get up-to-date information about your account's API usage in different time periods (minute, hour, day, week, month).
usage_notes: Usage Details: Track your API usage over the last minute, hour, day, week, and month.
Subscription Info: Get information about your subscription status and duration.
Provide your API key in the request to retrieve the data. The API will respond with a breakdown of your usage, subscription status, and the latest status of the Steam Web API.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Your API key for authentication. Retrieve it from your Dashboard (top-right corner).

responses.description: Successfully retrieved account and usage statistics.
Bad request or missing API key.
Unauthorized access due to invalid or missing API key.

details: Automates your Steam login process, including for trading, market, and other Steam Community features.
With the `steamLoginSecure` cookie, you can use our Trading API and build easy-to-use trading bots, market trackers, and more.
The login process is handled securely. No password is stored server-side.
Ideal for building trading bots, market analyzers, and automated session checkers.
usage_notes: There are two ways to authenticate: Username + Password Login, or Refresh Token Login.
For Username + Password Login, send a POST request with your Steam `username` and `password` in the request body.
If your account is protected by Steam Guard, include the `code` parameter from your mobile authenticator.
For Refresh Token Login, provide a `steamrefreshtoken` (JWT) instead of username/password.
Do not provide both login credentials and `steamrefreshtoken` at the same time.
The `steamrefreshtoken` is typically valid for up to 6 months and can be used repeatedly to retrieve new `steamLoginSecure` cookies.

request_body.description: JSON payload containing the required parameters for Steam login. There are two ways to authenticate: via username + password (optionally code from 2FA Mobile Authenticator), or via steamrefreshtoken only. You must provide either (username + password) or steamrefreshtoken – but not both.

properties.name: username
properties.description: Steam account username. Required if not using steamrefreshtoken.

properties.name: password
properties.description: Steam account password. Required if not using steamrefreshtoken.

properties.name: code
properties.description: Mobile authenticator code (2FA). Required if account has Steam Guard enabled and using username/password login.

properties.name: steamrefreshtoken
properties.description: JWT token returned from previous login. Can be used instead of username/password for reauthentication.
